fact: President Kibaki launched the Kenya Open Government Data Portal, www.opendata.go.ke, on 8 July 2011, to make large quantities of Government data (census, budgets and expenditures, schools, health facilities) available to the public in digital format.

The OGP record says Kenya launched the Kenya Open Data Initiative portal (Opendata.go.ke) in 2011 to make government-held data accessible to the public; it also says the portal has been offline for the last few years.
